tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 275)༄༅/rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying tig gi gro lod cho ga dang sbrel ba'i gtor bzlog btang na/yar gzhir rtsa gsum/'di nyid kyi sgrub gtor dpal
275)༄༅/rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying tig gi gro lod cho ga dang sbrel ba'i gtor bzlog btang na/yar gzhir rtsa gsum/'di nyid kyi sgrub gtor dpal

tei:div.tei:p: rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying tig gi gro lod cho ga dang sbrel ba'i gtor bzlog btang na/ yar gzhir rtsa gsum/ 'di nyid kyi sgrub gtor dpal gtor 'khor bcu gnyis/ ma mgon/ legs ldan/ gza'/ tshe ring*/ g.yu sgron/ dur khrod lha mo tsi dmar bcas dang*/ pho rgyud/ mo rgyud/ gter bdag gzhi bdag chad brtan/ tshe gtor/ dngos grub gtor ma/ tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ sman raka bcas/ bstar gnyis par/ skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu/ tshogs bdag srog sgrub/ rgyal po/ btsan/ de'i g.yas g.yon du bskang bshos dmar nag bcu gsum/ bstar gsum par/ mchod pa zhi drag mjug sprod/ bdag 'jug blang na/ dkyil 'khor ras bris khar/ sgrub gtor/ thod chang*/ gtor zan/ sngags phreng*/ mchod pa bskor bshams bcas/ 'og gzhir 276) ma tram gzugs kyi snying gar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi lha tshom can gyi khar/ mañdzi la bzlog gtor mthog mdil lta bu/ 'khor rigs bzhi/ ging bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ mtheb skyu grangs med pas bskor ba drag brgyan rngams brjid can/ de'i mtha' skor du/ rdo zor bzhi/ mtshe zor bzhi/ mda' zor bzhi/ khrag zor bzhi/ phur zor bzhi/ dug zor bzhi/ mtshon zor bzhi/ me zor bzhi/ sgong zor bzhi/ rtsang zor bzhi/ yungs zor bzhi/ bcas pa'i nang*/ rab chad dud pa/ ri rgyud phung sa/ tshon skud sna lnga/ mda'/ 'phang*/ lcags zangs dug khrag khram shing*/ rtsang bcas/ de mthar drag mchod bskor bshams/ nub re bzhin btang rgyu'i gsol ka'i gtor spungs/ thun gtor/ chad brtan/ tshogs/ dkar bgegs/ lam sel/ srid pa dkar gtor/ yang dkar gtor/ dmar 277) gtor/ skam thun/ rlon thun/ dbye sgro/ gdab phur/ sgrol gri/ tho ba/ hom gzar sogs nyer mkho tshogs par byas la/ cho ga dngos la/ sems bskyed sdom chog tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ sku gsum gsol 'debs/ chos sku kun tu bzang pa'i= 'di ltar mig gi= 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i= brgyud 'debs/ rgya chad phyogs lhung=

rol mo byin rlabs 'phros/ badzra ma hā shrī= sogs/ dkar bgegs snying tig spyi 'gro ltar/ sarba bighnaṃ= thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis kyis/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'khrul pa gzung 'dzin= smos ci dgos= sum gcig sumbha ni= sil/ sum gnyis/ dpal chen las byang gi srung 'khor/ hūm̐: bdag nyid zhe sdang= e hūm̐ phaṭa: 'jam rol gyis bzhag rang gi snying gi'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ che mchog padma drag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi 278)nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥhūm̐ hrīḥ chos sku'i ston pa= bskyab tu gsol: bar skyabs 'gro lan gsum/ hoḥm dad= gdul= bar gsum/ 'god bar bya'o: bar sems bskyed lan gsum/ dpal chen las byang gi tshogs bsags/ hoḥrdo rje slob dpon= chen por bsngo: bar lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ hoḥm rig rlabs kyis= sa ma ya hoḥ bar gyis dam bca'/ byin 'bebs la/ thing gsum/ sil gsum gnyis kyis/ dpal chen sgrub khog gi hūm̐/ bskal pa srid pa'i= shintaṃ gharbhas byin phob cig: bar dang*/ gzhung gi hūm̐ dpal chen rdo rje gro bo lod: sogs nas/ sarba siddhi hūm̐: bar/ brgyud gsum rol mo bzhag rol/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ dpal chen las byang gi hūm̐:dbyings nas yi ge= sarba pū dza ā hūm̐: zhi rol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa= gsum/ ma hā 279)ba lingta= gsum/ ma hā rakta= gsum/ gzhung gi ting 'dzin rnam gsum lhug 'don gyis/ hūm̐: rnam par mi rtog= hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bar/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ rten dang brten bskyed ni/ hūm̐ las zhe sdang 'bar ba'i= nas/ gdod nas lhun grub dkyil 'khor chen por shar: bar dang dpal chen las byang gi dbang bskur/ hūm̐:rang las shar ba'i= dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo badzra sa mā ha dzaḥ bar/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ spyan 'dren/ gzhung gi hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi= mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol:

gu ru= gnyis/ 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ bzhugs gsol/ bde chen chos sku= phyag 'tshal/ 'dod chags dag pas= shrī na ma: rjes su/ mchod pa rgyas pa dpal chen las byang gi hūm̐: sgeg pa 'jigs rung= phyag rgya bcas bya/ glu mchod/ hūm̐:dga' ba bcu drug= nyer spyod/ hūm̐: nyer spyod lnga dang= zhi rol/ drag mchod/ 280)hūm̐: 'dod chags khrag chen= sman mchod/ rdo rje'i dam tshig= hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: rjes su brgyud mchod gsol 'debs ltar/ rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba'i= dang po'i= longs sku= sprul sku= myong grol bdud rtsi= sarba= shri seng ha= 'jam dpal= dzñā na= myong grol= sarba= dzambu= nges par= thugs gter= mkha' 'gro'i= myong grol= sarba= snying rje'i= o rgyan= gdod ma'i= bka' drin= myong grol= sarba= dbang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dpal chen rta mgrin rdo rje gro bo lod: sras dang sprul pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: myong grol= sarba= bdud rtsi snying po can gyi dbus: sogs kyis dngos grub blang*/ hūm̐:bha ga yangs pa'i= sogs kyis gtor ma dang*/ hūm̐:lcang lor bcas pa'i= sogs kyis rakta dang*/ hūm̐: yab dang yum gyi= sogs kyi gsad mnan dang*/ hūm̐: rdo rje padma'i= sogs kyis sbyor sgrol mchod pa'i/ ta na 281) ga na pū dza hoḥ bar btang*/ sum gcig sil/ sum gnyis/ gzhal yas khang gi bstod pa/ ma bcos spros bral= tshogs la bshags: yig brgya/ 'jam rol gyis bzhag phaṭaḥdzaḥ zhes pas 'dzab khang dbye/ gong gi lha bskyed ldeb drug pa'i rgyab nas/ bdag mdun thugs kar rin chen zur brgyad= phreng ba bzhin: padma ta krita= lnga brgya/ hrīḥ gro bo lod= stong gcig 'od zer lcags kyi tsha= rol= phar bcad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: cung zad bsnyen/ rol chen gtor bzlog las srung ba'i dmigs bzlas/ gtso bo'i thugs srog gi klad kor du= gsal ba thugs srog las= mi tshugs par gyur: badzra shrī gro bo lod= sham du/ uṣṇi ṣa= sbyar ba lnga brgya/

bzlog sngags ni/ shrī gro bo lod= sham du/ oṃ lokt+ri pa la= brlag brlag: ldeb bco brgyad pa'i yum bka'i seng gdong ltar/ sangs rgyas kyis ni= ldeb gnyis pa'i/ 'grub par 282)gyur cig: thal mo gsum brdab/ trig nan myag thum= sbyar ba lnga brgya/ las sbyor bsnyen pa/ 'og gi ldeb bcu drug pa'i mdun nas/ badzra shrī gro bo lod= sham du/ oṃ rakṣa rā tsa'i tsitta zung= nas/ ma ra ya rbad: bar btags pa stong gcig bdag 'jug blangs nas las bum la dmigs te/ a mri ta kunḍa li= brgya tsam bzla/ dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ rten snying bcas gsum/ mchod phreng dri za'i rgyud mang*/ las byang gzhung mchod/ kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung= na maḥsarba ta tha ga te bhyo shi shwo= puṣpe= sogs/ 'dod yon/ rang 'phrul= dgyes mnyes mchog gi= bstod pa/ ma bcos spros bral= tshogs la bshags: yig rgya bcas/ dngos rol ltar mchod rdzas byin rlabs/ bla ma yi dam spyi gtor/ dam can spyi gtor/ gter mdzod gtor bsngos bcas sngon du song bas/ ma mgon 283) lcam dral/ legs ldan/ tshogs bdag gza'/ gnod sbyin/ srog sgrub/ tshe ring ma/ g.yu sgron ma/ dur khrod lha mo/ tsi'u dmar po/ rgyal po/ dgongs btsan/ dpe 'dzoms na/ las gshin/ rdor legs/ ge sar/ spom ra bcas/ kun chen bla ma ngag gi dbang po'i gsung rab bzhin dang*/ gser skyems rgyas bsdus/ gter bdag dang gzhi bdag spyi gtor bcas/ na rag skong bshags mar me'i smon lam yan/ tshogs zhus/ tshogs byin rlabs la/ thing gcig sum gnyis/ gzhung gi bkra shis mtshan ldan= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sum gnyis/ tshogs spyan dren/ oṃ/ bde bar gshegs so= gaṇḍe hoḥ 'jam rol/ bzhag rol/ spyir mchod pa/ mchod gdangs phyag rgya bcas/ ho/ dung mdog sgeg mo= spos kyi sprin lding= gzugs su snang ba= rnga 'don gyis/ tshogs rje tshogs bdag 284)dngos grub 'bebs/ sum gnyis/ hoḥ dbang chen rdo rje= bstsal du gsol:

yig brgya/ 'jam rol/ dgu klog gis/ bskul pa/ hūm̐ bhyo: bde chen chos dbyings= ru lu hūm̐: gsum pa bar/ dgu zlog sil/ sum gnyis/ gser skyems/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud= la/ khyad par dbang drag padma'i lha tshogs= zhes kha bsgyur/ sum gnyis/ gzhung gi gzu dpang*/ hūm̐ bhyo: ma nyes ma len= bka' yi chad tho btang*/ 'jam rol gyis bzhag lhag 'don gyis grub bskyed/ e ram̐ phaṭa ram̐:e:ngo mtshar bsad pa'i= gzas po gsal= bar dang*/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud= khyad par du bcom ldan 'das che mchog padma drag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod= 'gugs rol bcas lan gsum gyi gsum par dgu klog gis/ hūm̐ dzaḥ stobs bcu mnga' ba= gnyis med khug= tshar dgu/ dgu glog sil/ bzhag rol/ rtsa sngags la/ 285)dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥnṛ tri aṅku= bla sha re ma ti= sbrel ba sum brgya/ thun gdangs sam/ bzlog 'don gyis/ bhyo: las byed phra men= phob: dgu thing*/ hu tra hab len= sogs sngags tshar nyer gcig hūm̐: dpal chen gsang ba'i= len par byed: dgu thing gi mthar zil shin tu ring po'i 'og tu/ lokt+ri'i sngags dang*/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo= las sngags dgu tsam bzlas la bsgral/ dgu thing gis/ hūm̐: dbang chen rol pa'i= zhing chen la khā hiḥ bar/ dgu thing*/ sil dgu thing gis/ skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu tshang bar btang na/ mdor na rab 'byams= mgor/ spro na dngos rol ltar bskang rdzas byin rlabs/ lcam dral skong ba/ bhyo: ting 'dzin sprul pa'i= 'khrugs skong*/ phud bshal rnams gong du ma song na 'dir btang*/ tshe ring ma'i skong ba/ hūm̐: bde chen chos sku'i: bdag bstod do: 286) bar dang*/ btsan bskang*/ skyes bu srog gi bdag po ni: sogs nas/ sa las byed pho nya'i thugs dam bskang: bar dang*/ bshags pa/ oṃ/ ye shes las grub= yig brgya bcas/ phrin bcol/ kyai/ thub pa'i bstan pa= bkra shis stsol= bar/ 'di gtor ma bkyags dpyad min pa shes dgos/

mdor na rab 'byams= nas/ āḥ yan dang*/ tshogs drang ba/ cha gsum zin nas/ bdag 'jug blang na/ ji ltar bltams pa= sumbha ni= zhi rol/ maṇḍal/ rgyun bshags ni/ tshogs bar bshags kyi tshig ldeb bcu gnyis pa'i/ hoḥdabang chen rdo rje gro lod dgongs su gsolaḥ nas/ bstsal du gsol: bar/ sdom bzung ni/ sngon 'gro'i dam bca'i tshig ldeb gnyis pa'i/ ho: ma rig rlabs kyis= sa ma ya hoḥ bar dang*/ slob ma lhar bskyed cing ye shes dbab pa ni/ ldeb gsum pa'i/ hūm̐: rnam par mi rtog ye nas= ldeb brgyad pa'i spyan 'dren mtha'i/ gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: bar rol myur dal spel ma bya/ tiṣṭha badzra: zhes brtan par bya/ dngos gzhi'i don du maṇḍal gsol gdab/ ldeb nyi shu pa'i/ phung po khams dang skye mched tshogs: nas/ bdag gyur cig: bar lan gsum/ bum dbang gi don du gtor ma thogs la/ hūm̐ hrīḥ hūm̐ skyes gtor ma= snang zhen sbyangs: 'og gi sngags sbyar/ sngon 'gro ngag 'don gyi dbang len 287) las/ des lus kyi las dang rtsa yi= bzhag go gsang dbang gi don du thod chang thogs la/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bde gshegs yab yum= dbang bsgyur shog: 'og gi sngags kyis bdud rtsi'i myang*/ des ngag gi las dang rlung gi= bzhag go sher dbang gi don du gtor ma thogs la/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang bzhin lhun gyi grub pa= sngags bcas brjod/ des yid kyi las dang thig le'i= bzhag go dbang bzhi pa'i don du gtor ma thogs la/ hūm̐: tshad med rmad byung= sngags kyis gtor ma gnas bzhir bzhag gtor zan rol/ tshig dbang dngos ni/ hūm̐: ngo mtshar sprul pa'i= a a āḥ des kun gzhi'i las dang= bzhag go bar/ rjes 'brel bzlas lung gi slad du/ slob dpon kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ rang gi khar zhugs te snying gar thim par gyur/ padma ta krita= gsum/ badzra 288)shrī gro bo lod= gsum/ gtso bos ji ltar= maṇḍal/ deng nas brtsams te= bdag gi lus kyang bzhes su gsol/

bar brjod/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus padma thod phreng= thing gcig sum gnyis/ dpal chen las byang gi lhag ma/ kyai: dang po phud kyi= gyur ba'i phyir: lhag zhus/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta= puṣpe= mthar thing gcig sil/ bzlog rol che bas/ hūm̐: rnam dag rang bzhin= grub par mdzod: bzlog rol che ba/ sil/ bzlog rol che bas/ bzlog pa 'gres dgu ma ni/ dang po/ hūm̐ bhyo: 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i= rtsa sngags/ lokt+ri/ trig nan= phaṭaḥ bar/ gnyis pa/ hūm̐ bhyo: thugs slar zla gam= phaṭa: gsum pa/ hūm̐ bhyo: chos dbyings ye shes rnam snang gangs chen mtsho: rdo rje slob dpon buddha thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can= phaṭaḥ bzhi pa/ hūm̐ bhyo: me long ye shes rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can= phaṭaḥ lnga pa/ hūm̐ bhyo: mnyam nyid ye shes ratna thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can= 289)phaṭaḥ drug pa/ hūm̐ bhyo: sor rtogs ye shes padma thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can= phaṭaḥ bdun pa/ hūm̐ bhyo: bya grub ye shes karma thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can= phaṭaḥ brgyad pa/ hūm̐ bhyo: rigs bzhi'i ging chen mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas: ma dad sems can: phaṭaḥ dgu pa/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ phrin las bzhi sgrub dbang phyug sgo ma'i tshogs: ma dad sems can= bhyo zlog phaṭaḥ de rnams mtshams su dgu thing re re/ yang bskyar gter gzhung dngos bstan 'gres gsum kho na btang dgos pas/ hūm̐ bhyo: 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i= nas 'gres gcig hūm̐ bhyo: thugs kar zla gam= la 'gres gcig hūm̐ bhyo: chos dbyings ye shes= man 'gres gcig bcas la grangs bzung*/ mthar rtsa sngags/ lokt+ri/ trig nan= bcas sbrel ba'i bzlog sngags stong rtsa ya zung re bzla/ seng gdong ltar/ sangs rgyas kyis ni bdud pham mdzadaḥ nas/ deng 'dir bden pa 290)'grub gyur cig: ces thal mo gsum brdab/ yang bzlog pa grangs bzung*/ mtshams su bzlog sngags thal rdeb bya/ bzlog pa tshar tha ma'i gsham du rol pa chen po'i gtor bzlog ltar dbang phyug ma'i bzlog byang*/

bhyo: phrag mtsho 'bar ba'i khyams shed na: nas/ bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la bsgyur: bzlog rol che ba/ sil/ bzhag rol/ bzlog sngags thal rdeb bcas grub mtshams/ thun gtor la 'gugs pa gcig ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gcig oṃ ā hūm̐: gsum/ oṃ badzra shrī gro bo lod sarba siddhi hūm̐: sa pa ri wa ra i daṃ la lingta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ gsum/ dgu rkyang dang*/ dgu zlog gis/ dza bhyo rbadaḥ bhyo: do nub drag po sngags kyis byin rlabs pa'iḥ nas/ dus la bab:

lokti'i sham/ zor ma ra ya zor ya: e sa bhyo bzlog rbad ya: dgu bzlog che mchog padma drag brdung bcas kyis 'phangs/ 291) khro bo 'bar ba'i= nam mkha' med par= sogs brjod/ gsol ka gtor 'bul 'gugs pa nas bkra shis yan dang*/ sil/ sum gnyis/ bskul pa ldeb bcu gsum pa'i/ hūm̐ bhyo: bde chen chos dbyings sgyu 'phrul= ru lu gsum pa'i bar/ sum gnyis/ chad tho la/ ldeb bco brgyad pa'i rgyab nas/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus= dam las ma 'da' zhig: raksha si: bar dang*/ sum gnyis/ bstan ma/ dpal chen las byang gi bhyo: tshogs dang bka' yi bdag nyid ni: nas/ hūm̐ bhyo: hūm̐ hūm̐: sum gnyis/ rta bro gzhung gi hūm̐: e yi dkyil 'khor= ha ha ru lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ rjes chog mchod bstod bshags gsum/ gong gi ldeb dgu pa'i/ kun bzang mchod pa'i= nas/ tshogs la bshags: yig brgya/ bar/ rten bzhugs ni/ 'dir ni rten dang= su pra= bcas brjod/ lha snang bsdu ba 292) ni/ ldeb nyer gcig pa'i/ hūm̐: ngo mtshar sprul pa'i= a a āḥ cung zad mnyam par bzhag rjes thob zung 'jug gi skur ldang ba ni/ slar yang khams gsum 'gro ba'i= gar mdzod cig: bar dang*/ bsngo smon ni/ hoḥ lha mchog bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i= don rtogs shog: bar dang*/ bkra shis ni/ 'chi med zla gam dmar po= bde legs rtsol: bar/ zhi rol sbir/ bsod nams 'di yis= sogs smon lam rnams snying thig spyi ltar bya'o// grol nyin gtor bzlog than zlog bcas pa'i rjes su/ mchod bstod bshags pa/ gong gi ldeb dgu pa'i/ kun bzang mchod pa'i= nas/ sa tshogs la bshagasaḥ yig brgya lan gsum/ gtor ma'i ye shes sa mdun gyi nam mkha' btegs/ slar yang gtor chen zor rdzas dang bcas pa che mchog padma drag po dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad= sogs spyi ltar/ rngams par gyur/ 293) rjes su/ rtsa sngags/ lo kt+ri/ bzlog sngags dang sbrel ba dang*/ yang zlog rdo rje pha lam sngags sogs ci nus bzlas la zor rdzas sngags/

sangs rgyas kyis ni= sogs/ thal mo ldeb/ thun gtor 'gugs pa/ gcig ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ sngags bsngos/ gsum/ rol gong ltar gyis/ hūm̐: bcom ldan padma drag po 'khor bcas la: sogs nas/ 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: bar/ spyi gtor gyis thun gtor/ tshogs grol/ yar tshogs nas/ sgo dbye'i rol mo spyi 'gros ltar la/ rol pa chen po'i gtor bzlog gi sgo dbye/ ldeb zhe gcig pa las/ hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor na: phyag rgya bzhi ldan sgo srung= sogs nas/ bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ bskul pa/ ldeb bcu gsum pa'i/ hūm̐ bhyo: bde chen chos dbyings sgyu 'phrul: ru lu gsum bar= chad tho ldeb bco brgyad 294) pa'i rgyab nas/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'dus dus= raksha si: sum gcig zil/ che mchog padma gshar/ gtor tshugs steng dgu zlog gi bskul pa/ ldeb bcu gsum pa'i/ hūm̐ bhyo: bde chen chos dbyings= ru lu gsum bar/ gser skyems/ rol chen gtor bzlog ldeb zhe gcig pa'i rgyab nas/ hūm̐: phyogs gzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bcur: sogs nas/ 'grub par mdzod: dkar gtor dang*/ dmar gtor bcas 'bul/ che mchog padma/ bzhag rol/ sngar ltar pheṃ 'phags dgu zlog gis yar bskul gong ltar/ gser skyems rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud/ gtor chung steng mtshams dang sgrags na rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud btang zin nas/ 'dir phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad bya chog srid ho sgrog 'gugs pa tshar gcig 'gugs rol 'phros dgu thing gis/ dpal chen lam zor/ ldeb zhe gnyis pa'i/ hūm̐: dpal chen 295)rol pa'i pho nya= bcad pa'i phyiraḥ klad pa'i dkyil su gtor zor ya: 'og gi rabs chad dud pas man/ sngags bcas dgu thing kho na/ 'ur dgu thing gis/ hūm̐: dpal chen rol pa'i= bcad pa'i phyiraḥ nyan ba'i rna la mtshe zor ya: rabs chad dud pa/ sngags bcas/ de'i 'gres kyi/ mda'/ khrag phur/

dug mtshon/ me/ sgong*/ rtsang*/ yungs zor bcas 'phangs nas/ bzlog rol che bas/ dbang phyug ma'i bzlog pa/ bhyo: khrag mtsho 'bar ba'i khyams shed na: sogs nas/ bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: bzlog rol/ sil/ bzhag 'gugs pa tshar gcig 'gugs rol dgu zlog gi rgyun gtor ldeb bco brgyad pa'i rgyab nas/ dzaḥbhyo rbad: bhyo:do nub= srog sngags kyi/ rbad yaḥ che mchog 296) padma lan gsum gyis 'phang rjes/ dgu zlog gi dpal chen srung 'khor/ hūm̐: bdag nyid zhe sdang= e hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bzhag rol/ sgo drung du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ thing gcig sil gsum/ bhyo: tshogs dang bka' yi= mthar bzhag rol/ 'gugs pa/ 'gugs rol/ sum gnyis/ bro mnan/ sil/ bkra shis rol mo/ bkra shis/ 'chi med zla gam= sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ nang du log nas/ tshe bsnyen/ thing gcig sil/ sum gnyis/ oṃ: rang snang zangs mdog= sogs rig 'dus tshe 'gugs kyis/ badzra rakṣa: bar/ sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ gral du 'khod nas/ sum gnyis kyis/ dngos grub skul pa dpal chen gyi/ hūm̐: byin rlabs kun gyi rtsa ba= siddhi pha la hūm̐: sum brdung grangs med mthar bzhag rol/ gsol ka bkyag rjes chog mchod bstod man sngar nyin ltar byas pas 'grub bo// 297) 'di'i sgo nas rgyal rdzong 'di btang na/ dmag 'khrugs/ dgra gyod mi kha/ nad yams/ lo nyes/ sde dgon nang 'khrugs sogs zhi ba la gal che bas/ snod chen po gcig gi nang du/ snal ma bran pa'am/ zan gyis bcos pa'i khang bzang ljang gu kha bad dmar po/ gser gyi rgya phibs/ sgo mo dung*/ rdzongs yas rtsigs pa can 'dom gang ngam/ mda' gang ngam/ khru gang bas mi chung ba de'i dbus su rgyal po bandhe btsun gzugs/ pho brang gi g.yas su bud med nag mo bya rog mgo mdun du byis pa/ g.yon du liṅga dmar po gyen 'greng*/ rgyab du khyi dmar/ stag pa'i pho tang brgya/ glang ma'i mo tang brgya/ smyug gi rgyang bu brgya/ nam mkha' bya spus brgyan pa brgya/

smyug ma'i mda' bkra brgya/ gsoms pa'i 'phang bkra brgya/ chang bu brgya/ sha dum/ zan chad/ gos dum/ 298)ras sna/ dang tshe/ mig mang*/ mdos byang la bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ yul 'khor/ sa gzhi/ rgya mtsho/ ri rab/ nyi zla/ gza' skar/ 'ja' tshon/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ cang shes rta/ ma rmos lo tog dpag bsam shing*/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ de rnams brgya re'am/ lo grangs tsam gyis bskor ba bshams/ snod gcig gi nang 'dra glud spus legs la byi thur sgro yi skra/ lung tang mig dar dmar lce/ bse ru'i sha/ mtshal gyi khrag dung gi rus pa/ shel rgyus/ dbang lag yan lag glud lo grangs/ ting lo lo grangs/ mar me lo grangs/ nam mkha'/ rgyang bu/ mda'/ 'phang*/ pho tang*/ mo tang*/ mdos byang*/ lan chags/ sha dum/ zan chad rnams/ lo grangs kyis bskor ba nad pa lta bu'i sger mdos la chog spyi mdos 299) lta bur/ pho glud/ mo glud/ ban glud gsum la/ glud rdzas thams cad brgya res bskor ba dgos/ gso rdzas nyin re bzhin/ lan chags brgya/ sha dum brgya/ zan chad brgya/ gos dum brgya/ 'bru sna/ sman sna/ rin chen phye ma/ zas sna rnams dang*/ glud gso dpyad glud chung brgya re/ chang bu brgya/ 'bru sna/ yos bkra/ zas sna sogs gang 'joms bcas tshogs par bya/ gtor bzlog dus/ bzlog sngags thal brdeb yan zin nas/ lhug 'don gyis rgyal rjong gi dbu nas/ hrīḥ bla ma bde mchog 'khor lo= gnyis med gsal/ swa bha wa= stong pa'i ngang las= gter chen por gyur/ swa bha wa= na ma sarba ta tha ga te bhyo= badzra a mṛ ta= sambha ra= dzñā na a ba na ma sa manta= lan gsum res brlab/ thing gsum/ sil/ dgu thing gis/ hrīḥ ngang nyid dbyings 300)las= bka' la nyon/ dgu thing*/ de nas grangs gsog ni/ sambha ra/ gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang= sogs bzhi/ lan gcig kyai/ srid pa'i 'dre lnga/ phyin chad gnod pa ma ston cig dgu thing*/ yang*/ sambha ra= gnyis/

mtshan bzhi/ kyai/ srid pa'i 'dre lnga= nas tshar brgya'am/ tha na lo grangs tsam btang*/ yang glud bsngo ba ni/ sambha ra= gsum/ mtshan bzhi/ kyai/ mi bas glung bzang= bsngos zhing sbyin pas tshim gyur cig dgu thing*/ des 'gres tshar brgya'am/ tha na lo grangs tsam btang nas/ gtor bzlog la 'jug grol nyin sgo dbye/ bskul/ chad tho'i gsham du/ rgyal rdzong ga ི bde mchog 'khor lo'i de ltar blta/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las= sdig pa ci yang= 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ rjes su/ zor gong dang 'dra/ gtor bzlog dang mi 301) sbrel bar rgyal rdzong 'di btang na/ las byang*/ bsnyen pa/ stong tshig gsol ka tshogs byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren/ spyir mchod/ bye brag tshogs dang po bar bshags rjes/ tshogs bsgral pa/ hūm̐: dpal chen gsang ba'i bka' las= sngags bcas kyis bsgral/ zhal bstab 'phros/ thol glu'i tshogs drang ba/ lhag ma bcas zin nas/ rgyal mdos gzhung la 'jug grangs bsags zin nas/ sgo dbye/ las byang bskul/ chad tho/ lam bstan/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i= nas/ bstan pa yin/ bar thun gtor 'phang tshig dang*/ gang zhig mtshan mo= 'i rjes/ che mchog padmas 'phang*/ srung 'khor/ tshe 'gugs/ gsol ka bkyag bstan ma/ rta bro/ rjes chog mchod bstod man sngar ltar ro/ 'di nyid kyi sgo nas 'khrul pa sbubs bshig dang 'dre 'dul 302) bya na/ yig cha dang lag len zur du bkol pa ltar shes par bya'o/ skye bar mtsho skyes rgyal ba gtsug tu thogs// snga 'gyur nang rgyud gsum gyi mthu thob nas// a li ka li'i spyod pas lam mthar phyin// tshe 'dir zung 'jug 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog zhes pa'ang rdo rje 'dzin pa khang sprul gar dbang chags pa'i rdo rje'i bzhed skong du zab gter 'di'i dang po'i smin grol gyi skal bar ldan pa sngags 'chang dpal chen 'dus pas bris pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis//
